_note_factoryRoot: unused by code - FACTORY_ROOT is always derived from this module's own location (src/lib.mjs), overridable via UAOS_FACTORY_ROOT
_note_scratchRoots: worktreeRoot/artifactRoot/buildCacheRoot are portable repo-relative defaults, resolved via src/paths.mjs. Override with UAOS_FACTORY_WORKTREE_ROOT / UAOS_FACTORY_ARTIFACT_ROOT / UAOS_FACTORY_BUILD_ROOT (or set these fields to an absolute D:/E: path locally, uncommitted) to use dedicated drives again.
_note_lanes: repoRoot is intentionally null in committed config - lane repositories point at real, separate product repos this checkout cannot contain. Resolve them via src/lane-repositories.mjs: UAOS_ARRANGER_REPO_ROOT / UAOS_LIBRARY_REPO_ROOT / UAOS_SINGY_REPO_ROOT env vars, an uncommitted config/factory.local.json (see config/factory.local.example.json), or UAOS_PRODUCT_REPO_SEARCH_ROOTS discovery. A lane with no repoRoot resolves to LANE_REPOSITORY_NOT_CONFIGURED and blocks only that lane.

library.note: Shares the arranger product's source in real deployments; isolated via factory worktrees and path allowlists
